items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was called to play on maybe about four or five of them [films]... As a result of meeting him here and playing on those recordings... he invited me to play on this project with Count Basie.

ctx.x: Okay. So this was – he had a very large orchestra on this one.

Really? I do remember recording with Count Basie, though. I remember that, because Oliver Nelson wrote the charts on it. In fact, he was the one that invited me to play with that – in that recording in New York. I remember that.
Can you talk about your relationship with Oliver Nelson?
